purpose: Measure natural radio-utility complementarity between conventional cuPHY and NeuralRx on the exact same valid PUSCH channel realization.

radio.channel: independent block-Rayleigh coefficient per RX antenna and complex AWGN
radio.snr_definition: mean post-fading resource-grid power / mean complex noise power

receiver_order: conventional then NeuralRx on the identical immutable noisy slot
interpretation_limit: The channel is a reproducible block-Rayleigh plus AWGN model implemented on the Aerial-generated grid, not a live RF or full 3GPP CDL trace.
